name: skill_control
title: Flowork Skill Control
description: Kendali dan kurasi SOP keahlian khusus Flowork OS (skills/). Aksi: 'create' (scaffold SOP skill baru dengan 20 kata kunci Bahasa Inggris otomatis), 'publish' (publikasikan skill ke repositori resmi), 'pin' (sematkan 1 skill ke sesi aktif), 'unpin' (lepas skill), 'read' (baca runbook SOP), 'status' (status skill aktif).
author: Flowork Sovereign Core

components.name: Live Skill Engine Activator Box
components.description: In-chat ephemeral SOP mounting terminal verifying 20 English keywords and mounting runbooks

components.name: Dedicated Sovereign Skill HUD Card
components.description: Interactive card representing pinned, running, or available SOP skills

components.name: Quantum Protocol Skill Engagement Card
components.description: Tactical HUD engagement card for active pinned skills

action.description: Aksi: 'create' (scaffold skill baru dengan 20 keywords English), 'publish' (publikasikan skill ke repositori resmi), 'pin' (sematkan skill ke sesi aktif), 'unpin' (lepas skill), 'read' (baca runbook SOP), 'status' (status skill aktif).

description.description: Deskripsi runbook SOP dalam Bahasa Inggris (opsional saat action='create').

instructions.description: Isi runbook SOP markdown (opsional saat action='create', otomatis diisi template 4 bab baku jika kosong).

keywords.description: Daftar kata kunci Bahasa Inggris (opsional saat action='create', otomatis diperkaya menjadi tepat 20 keywords).

name.description: Nama tampilan skill manusiawi (opsional saat action='create').

notes.description: Catatan rilis/fitur saat mempublikasikan skill baru (opsional saat action='publish').

overwrite.description: Set true untuk menimpa jika skill_id sudah ada (opsional saat action='create', default: false).

reason.description: MANDATORY ON EVERY TOOL CALL: Clear, concise technical rationale explaining WHY you are calling this tool right now and what specific action it performs (displayed live to the user on every tool HUD and used on the first call to recall up to 3 memories from .fl_brain).

skill_id.description: ID skill yang dituju (contoh: 'sql_query_optimizer', 'network_pentest_recon'). Diperlukan saat create, pin, unpin, read, publish.
